sos_button_visible_by_default.description: Show the full-width SOS button on a fresh install.

voice_button_visible_by_default.description: Show the 'Say a Command' voice bar on a fresh install.

high_contrast_by_default.description: Start new installs in high-contrast mode.

fall_detection_enabled_by_default.description: Turn fall detection on by default. Note: requires the physical-activity permission, so leaving this off avoids an unprompted permission ask.

fall_sensitivity_default.description: Default fall-detection sensitivity. One of LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH (case-insensitive). Anything else falls back to MEDIUM.

sos_hold_duration_ms.description: How long the SOS button must be held to fire, in milliseconds. Clamped to 1000–10000 in-app.

sos_countdown_seconds.description: Seconds the SOS countdown screen ticks (with a Cancel button) before dispatching. Clamped to 3–30 in-app.

favorite_apps_max_count.description: How many apps the Home screen's My Apps row shows. Clamped to 4–24 in-app.
